_comment: TASK_CARD_07 Part A. '科技/软件' maps directly onto the real, ETF-tracked Technology SPDR sector (kind: sector) - no approximation needed. 'AI 基建' and '航天/太空' have no single tracking sector, so they use a hand-curated ticker basket (kind: basket) per the card's own explicitly-sanctioned '篮子近似' allowance. These basket ticker lists are a manually-assembled, illustrative approximation - NOT a verified or official sector/industry classification, and membership has not been individually re-verified live the way every other data source in this repo has been. Coverage against the actual gate-passed universe (some basket tickers may not pass the STANDARD/SMALL_SPEC profile gate, may be delisted, or may not exist) is computed and disclosed at runtime rather than assumed - see src/screen/sector_scan/computeHotSectorDetail.ts.
